entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that receives downlink user data packets and processes them according to 3GPP specifications.

entities.name: Downlink User Data Packet
entities.description: A data packet transmitted from the network to the UE, marked with QFI and RQI parameters.

entities.name: QoS Flow Identifier
entities.description: Identifier for a QoS flow in 5G systems, used to classify and manage quality of service for data packets.

entities.name: Reflective QoS Indication
entities.description: Indication used in reflective QoS to signal that uplink packet filters should be derived from downlink packets.

entities.name: Packet Filter Derivation Condition
entities.description: Condition where it is not possible to derive an uplink packet filter from the received downlink user data packet as specified in subclause 6.2.5.1.4.2.

entities.name: RQI Ignore Behavior
entities.description: UE behavior where the RQI is ignored and the downlink user data packet is handled normally when packet filter derivation is not possible.

relations.description: The downlink user data packet is marked with a QFI identifier.
The downlink user data packet is marked with an RQI identifier.
UE behavior is guarded by the condition that packet filter derivation is not possible.
When packet filter derivation is not possible, the UE establishes the behavior of ignoring RQI and handling the downlink packet.
